azerbaijan-law (public, pinned fb5e2fa = main) holds the 1995 Constitution with its 2002, 2009 and 2016 referendum amendments, every essential code, and 6,601 of the 6,612 in-force laws, constitutional laws and codes listed from e-qanun.az, with in-force history to 2026-10-27; a Criminal Procedure Code amendment of 30.06.2026 and Constitution art. 101 match the official texts. But history before 2021 is thin (the Constitution's 1995 version has 111 of 165 article files, 54 articles appear only from the date of their first amendment, and 1,253 commits are labelled 'several' or 'unexplained'), sub-laws, Nakhchivan's own laws and all case law are not held.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
